projects.description: Personal research website and selected spatial-analysis portfolio

assets.title: Selected GIS and spatial-analysis client portfolio
assets.summary: LiDAR-first portfolio with eight selected samples and interactive Haiti surface reconstruction; wireframe and mesh-vertex modes; supporting investment scenario.
limits: No new scientific analysis or replication performed
External demo URLs checked; comprehensive scientific or interaction audit of those apps not repeated

assets.title: GIS portfolio selected-asset provenance
assets.summary: Selected output hashes, source identities, transformations and scope limits; no private communication or raw source material.
limits: Does not independently validate scientific source results or grant publication approval.

assets.title: Spatial Investment Lab
assets.summary: Asheville 3D public-data policy scenario: additionality, displacement, constrained allocation and earnings-group accessibility.
limits: Policy response parameters are illustrative, not estimated.
No fiscal return, general equilibrium, wages or agglomeration model.
Roads and employment have different vintages; external employment is excluded.
Cesium shows Upgrade for commercial use; account entitlement was not changed.
Existing environment and GitHub-secret connection reused; browser credential remains visible by design; token restrictions not independently verified.

assets.title: Asheville public employment and directed road graph
assets.summary: Explicit LODES/OSM inputs with source hashes, retrieval query, aggregation and coverage; no client material.
limits: Cross-vintage, bounded study window; grid and snapping approximations.
OSM-derived graph and geometry subject to ODbL attribution.

assets.title: Spatial incentive allocation and accounting procedure
assets.summary: Tested pure implementation with explicit conditional assumptions, conservation and allocation checks.
limits: Scenario mechanics only; no identified causal effect or investment recommendation.

assets.title: Haiti coastal terrain mesh excerpt
assets.summary: Public-source geometry from archived GLB export, clipped to exclude zero-filled padded boundary; ECEF to local frame; textures excluded.
limits: 100 m sampling; land exaggerated 1.2x and seabed 6x.
Not LiDAR, photogrammetry, or navigation data.
